verdict.rationale: GoDaddy offers a REST API authenticated with scoped Personal Access Token bearer credentials and shows plain curl calls, so it can run unattended in scripts without a browser. Automation is backed by an end-to-end workflow guide (curl, Node, Python, Go), OpenAPI specs, rate-limit headers, stable error codes and the `gddy` CLI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance or examples, documented non-interactive (token-based) auth for the `gddy` CLI (docs only say 'authenticate once' with a session), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless use.
